<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<LightningComponentBundle xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata">
    <apiVersion>62.0</apiVersion>
    <isExposed>true</isExposed>
    <masterLabel>Integration Hub Setup</masterLabel>
    <description>Guided setup of an Integration Event or Connection: steps with help, side summary, checks and save. On a record page it shows a read-only summary; admins get Edit.</description>
    <targets>
        <target>lightning__RecordPage</target>
    </targets>
    <targetConfigs>
        <targetConfig targets="lightning__RecordPage">
            <property name="mode" type="String" label="Mode" datasource="view,edit" default="view"
                description="view: read-only summary (admins get Edit). edit: the guided steps."/>
            <objects>
                <object>IH_Event__c</object>
                <object>IH_Connection__c</object>
            </objects>
        </targetConfig>
    </targetConfigs>
</LightningComponentBundle>
